title: Senior Product Designer (Webflow) Temp to Perm
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 Senior Product Designer (Webflow)

 At Current

 At Current, Senior Product Designers (Webflow) lead the design and delivery of engaging digital experiences across multiple client engagements. You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams across strategy, production, engineering, and client services to create thoughtful, user-centered websites that are both beautifully designed and expertly built in Webflow.

 Senior Product Designers are strategic, hands-on creators. You're equally comfortable conducting UX discovery, designing polished experiences in Figma, and building production-ready websites in Webflow. You own projects from concept through launch, partnering with engineering only when advanced custom development or integrations are required.

 What You'll Do

• Lead UX and visual design across websites and digital experiences for multiple client engagements

• Partner with strategy, production, engineering, and client stakeholders to define user experience and creative direction

• Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs in Figma

• Design and build responsive, production-ready websites directly in Webflow

• Develop scalable design systems, reusable components, and CMS structures in Webflow

• Translate business goals into intuitive, accessible, and conversion-focused digital experiences

• Collaborate with engineers on advanced functionality, integrations, and custom development when needed

• Optimize websites for usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and SEO

• Conduct UX reviews and recommend improvements based on best practices and user insights

• Stay current on UX trends, accessibility standards, and evolving Webflow capabilities

 What You'll Bring

• 5–7 years of UX/UI, Product, or Digital Design experience, ideally within an agency or consulting environment

• 2+ years building production-ready websites in Webflow

• Advanced proficiency with Figma and Webflow

• Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership from UX strategy through final Webflow implementation

• Experience building scalable Webflow websites using CMS Collections, Components, and design systems

• Experience with Client-First methodology, Relume, and Finsweet Attributes

• Strong understanding of UX, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and information architecture

• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS with the ability to partner effectively with engineers

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 Nice to Have

• Experience with Lottie, GSAP, or interactive animations

• Experience integrating Webflow with HubSpot, Memberstack, Airtable, Zapier, Make, or similar platforms

• Experience using analytics or A/B testing to inform design decisions

• Familiarity with Jira, Workfront, or similar project management tools

• Experience working within Agile delivery environments

 Why Current

 At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

 We're a remote-first agency with teams across the U.S., working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

 This is a temporary-to-permanent opportunity . The role will begin as a hourly position, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time employee based on business needs and individual performance.

 The target hourly compensation range for the temporary portion of this role is $45.00 - $65.00 per hour . If converted to full-time, the target range of base compensation for this role is $100,000 - $125,000 annually . Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/current-senior-product-designer-webflow-temp-to-perm

title: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 About the Role

 As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

 Key Responsibilities

• Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.

• Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.

• Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.

• Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.

• QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.

• Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.

• Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.

• Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.

• Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.

• Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

 Qualifications

 Required

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.

• Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.

• Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.

• Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.

• A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.

• Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.

• Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

• Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

 Preferred

• Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.

• Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.

• Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).

• Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.

• Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).

• Agency or consulting experience.

 Why Current

 At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

 We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

 You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

 This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/current-freelance-marketo-email-engineer

About Equity Trade Operations Analysts:

The Equity Trade Operations Analyst works as part of a global team performing and reviewing exception handling across all accounts and products and for all levels of complexity. They independently apply experience and judgement to analyzing exceptions, identifying the appropriate course of action, determining who should be involved in resolving the issue or exception, and implementing solutions. For particularly complex/ambiguous issues, they work with the Lead Analyst to determine the appropriate course of action. They possess a growth

mindset and proactively identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement efforts with oversight from the Lead as needed. The role may lead small to moderately sized internal or external projects and priorities.

Role Summary:

  • Performs and/or monitors more complex operational duties for investment vehicles servicing the Institutional, Retail, and High-Net Worth distribution channels. Performs trade confirmation, processing, settlement and claims for global equity markets.
  • Identifies, recommends, and participates in continuous improvement activities.

Required Skills/Abilities:

Able to assess issues, identify potential solutions, and implement changes/improvements to achieve the right outcomes and that have tangible and impactful implications for the business. For complex/ambiguous issues, will collaborate with Lead Analyst on best course of action
  • Proactively identify opportunities and drive implementation with oversight as needed
  • Ability to lead and effectively manage process and procedural changes
  • Ability to apply a global mindset when working through issues or developing solutions
  • Existing knowledge of, or ability to quickly assimilate to, Capital Group-specific institutional practices and knowledge (e.g., knowledge of the investment management industry as it relates to Capital Group's various lines of business (e.g., Retail, Institutional, High Net Worth), investment mandates, investment vehicle structures, investment operations, competitive landscape, and reporting and regulatory environment. Exhibits and shares knowledge in policies, practices, trends, technology, and information affecting the department/business area)
  • Self-driven (e.g., independently manage workload and achieve target outcomes)
  • Strong business acumen to understand and anticipate business needs/requirements and use business language in verbal and written communications
  • Work effectively across internal and external stakeholder groups with the appropriate level of urgency to solve issues and deliver outcomes in a timely manner
  • Strong collaboration skills, working within and across teams and stakeholder groups to proactively develop strong working relationships
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills including with senior stakeholders/leadership with a focus on being able to communicate 'the why' behind issues
  • Strong appetite and capability to shape and deliver continuous improvement activity
  • Demonstrates a deep understanding of the technology applications that are needed to support the business

title: Client Enablement Lead
description:
Headquarters: New York City, Remote

 Alloy is where you belong!

 Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces , Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers , Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker , year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here .

 About the team

 Alloy’s platform is complex and managed with high-touch support from Alloy’s Technical Solutions team. Customers that would like to ‘self-serve’ often struggle to build a clear mental model of how Alloy works and why, falling back to Alloy’s support teams to complete even simple tasks. Today, enablement is spread across multiple repositories and handled one-to-one by delivery teams, with inconsistent results. Only a handful of sophisticated and adventurous clients currently achieve a moderate amount of self-sufficiency.

 This leader owns customer enablement across Alloy. This is not a technical writing role. It is a role that builds and runs the program behind enablement: capturing knowledge continuously, packaging it for the right audience at the right moment, running hands-on customer training sessions, and measuring what works.

 The Customer Enablement Lead will report to the VP of Product Design. From within the Product team they will help fill gaps and challenging areas of the product while creating a powerful feedback loop between customers and designers to decrease those gaps and challenges over time. The Enablement Lead will form strong cross-functional connections with the Support, Delivery, Technical Success, Product Marketing, and Product Operations teams to ensure customers have a seamless and supported experience as they go live and as we release new features.

 Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week. This role is open to both local and remote candidates in the US.

 What you'll own

 The initial scope of work for this role will include:

 Close Critical Gaps

 Audit the current state. Evaluate and consolidate existing resources (API docs, help articles, the learning center, in-product help, and delivery-built guides). Work with cross-functional partners to create any missing documentation and “Customer 101” program material.

 Outcome : Our AI support bot can answer essentially any customer question. Our delivery teams can pull together the content they need to run tailored training sessions with their customers.

 Deliver the Alloy New Customer Enablement Program

 Focus on new Alloy customers and deliver scalable, deployable training and content for repeatable implementations. Structure material so clients can self-pace from foundational to advanced. Target key user personas so they learn the features critical to their respective day-to-day.

 Outcome : Clients understand and use what they bought, and are aware of what else Alloy offers. Additionally they know where to look for additional guidance via documentation, AI support chat, and other escalation channels.

 Build the Product Release Enablement Program

 When Alloy builds a material new feature or capability, map what each client segment and persona needs to know, when, and why, from pre-sales through go-live and ongoing use, and make it part of how products are sold, launched, and delivered.

 Outcome : a shared view of our friction points and what areas currently drag the most on our bottom line.

 Facilitate the Feedback Loop

 Collect feedback after every release, rollout, and training. Give Product, Design, and Delivery a shared view of where clients get stuck, and drive alignment on whether each gap is best solved by product, technical solutions, or enablement, including interim fixes.

 Outcome : Product, Design, and Delivery share one view of enablement gaps and who owns them. The design team gets critical insight continuously, addressing customer confusion directly in the product, helping reduce the surface area for documentation over time.

 Milestones

 30 Days

 Onboarding into Alloy, learning the product yourself, existing resource audit, gap analysis, start filling documentation gaps with SME and tooling support, and deliver a consolidation plan.

 60 Days

 Initial enablement ‘package’ in beta for first client feedback via early hands-on training sessions.

 90 days

 Initial enablement funnel for core segments deployed and documentation gap filling has demonstrated a measurable increase in AI support ticket resolution. Iteration on the enablement package incorporating early feedback.

 Six Months

 Enablement package is ‘production ready’ and universally rolled out (client-facing teams are ready to deliver training using the material). Feedback loop with product and design solidified. The product release enablement funnel is operational as part of new feature releases. Seeing measurable improvements in some areas of self-service and legacy support ticket theme avoidance.

 Who we’re looking for

 Must-haves:

• 7+ years in customer education, enablement, or training, including building a customer enablement program from the ground up.

• Experience enabling customers on a technical, API-driven B2B SaaS product, with the depth to learn complex workflows and teach them clearly.

• Strong live facilitation. You've run hands-on training sessions with customers and adapted them in the room.

• A track record of tying enablement to measurable outcomes such as ticket deflection, adoption, or time to value.

• Experience influencing Product, Support, Delivery, and Marketing partners without direct authority.

• The judgment to tell when a customer problem needs content, a training, or a product fix, and the writing skills to make the case.

 Nice-to-haves:

• Background in fintech, identity verification, fraud, or compliance.

• Experience structuring knowledge bases for AI support agents or chatbots.

• Hands-on experience with LMS, documentation, or in-product guidance tools.

• Experience working inside a Product or Design organization.

 Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!

 This position has a salary range of $180,000 to $220,000.

 Benefits and Perks

• Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy

• Employee stock options

• Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options

• 401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation

• Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave

• Home office stipend for new employees

• Annual Learning & Development annual stipend

• Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health

• Hybrid work environment: Local employees are expected to work Tuesdays through Thursdays from our HQ in Union Square, Manhattan. Tasty lunches catered from a variety of local restaurants and frequent employee-organized cultural events contribute to our positive office energy. On Monday/Friday most employees Zoom into work from home while some take advantage of the quieter office.

 How to apply

 Apply right here! You've found the application!

 Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. title: Staff Software Engineer, Revenue Systems
description:
Headquarters: New York City; Remote

 Squarespace is seeking a talented Staff Software Engineer to support and evolve the systems at the core core of our monetization platform: billing, payments and orders. In this role, you will provide technical oversight over the critical monetization machinery that accepts orders, processes payments and bills subscriptions. You will regularly collaborate with engineering leadership and key product, strategy and finance stakeholders to align technical strategy with Squarespace’s business objectives. This is an opportunity to take on IC technical leadership responsibilities and own system architecture for high-visibility initiatives tied directly to Squarespace's core businesses.

 This role is open to remote or hybrid working from our NYC office 3 days per week. You will report to the Director of Revenue Systems.

 You'll Get To...

• Own system architectural vision and design for critical areas of our business.

• Transform high-level system vision into estimated project plans for initiatives central to Squarespace’s strategy.

• Serve as technical lead and cross-functional liaison on business-critical projects, making and defending engineering decisions key to the success of the business.

• Mentor engineers on the team to deliver ever greater quality with ever growing autonomy.

• Drive best practices for engineering excellence and technical leadership, influence design reviews, question assumptions, point out pitfalls and foster shared understanding

• Set the engineering quality bar for the team through regular, high-quality code contributions across billing, orders and payments.

 Who We're Looking For

• 10 or more years experience specifying, delivering and maintaining complex distributed backend services.

• Significant experience with multiple programming languages (especially Java) and a broad range of tools like Springboot, hibernate, databases, etc.

• Demonstrated experience leading system architecture decisions across multiple teams or initiatives

• Proven ability to serve as a technical lead on cross-functional projects, aligning engineering and business goals without sacrificing engineering quality

• Experience working with billing, orders or payment systems at scale

 Benefits & Perks

• A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision

• Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans

• Fertility and adoption benefits

• Headspace mindfulness app subscription

• Global Employee Assistance Program

• Retirement benefits with employer match

• Flexible paid time off

• 12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave

• Pretax commuter benefit

• Education reimbursement

• Employee donation match to community organizations

• 7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• Dog-friendly workplace

• Free lunch and snacks

• Private rooftop

• Hack week twice per year

 Cash Compensation Range: $170,000 - $299,000 USD

 The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.

 In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.

 Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers .

Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. title: Lead, Specialist Solution Engineer Marketing Cloud
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Salesforce Public Sector Specialists Solutions Engineering team is a team of technology, industry and business process experts who are the partner for all public organizations and education institutions. We support their transformation and help them modernize their processes in order to deliver on their missions to citizens and businesses.

This position is dedicated to supporting the UK and Ireland Public Sector and Education Marketing Cloud Sales team.

Salesforce Marketing Cloud is a leader in AI driven digital marketing automation across email, mobile, social and web. Presenting to audiences ranging from operational marketing and IT teams to C-Level executives and public servants, the ideal candidate must be motivated and capable of delivering memorable presentations and demonstrations while knowledgeably supporting the discussion of our marketing solutions to all levels of detail.

About the Requirements

Primary requirements

The candidate will ideally have the following competencies and experience:

  • A proven track record of success - ideally a minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role (Solution Consultant, Consultant, Project Lead, ideally in the marketing technology area)
  • AI fluency : experience using Codex, Claude Code or any other AI tool to code / configure / craft assets is a strong plus
  • Hands on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement or Marketing Cloud Next (Certification is a plus)
  • Be able to work with an extended team to plan and implement upon a targeted engagement campaign
  • Having the curiosity and tenacity to undertake deep, relevant client discovery and to ensure that the resulting presentation and solution demonstration solves for the identified business challenges
  • Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills, comfortable presenting to teams, occasionally larger groups, CMOs and senior officers.
  • A passion for storytelling to bring customer engagements to life using impactful presentation and solution demonstration content
  • Having a results driven mentality to maximize the impact of all Marketing Cloud solution messaging in a language that resonates with the customer
  • Agility to thrive with change, and variety, often working across multiple concurrent customer engagements
  • Be an autonomous self-starter that is able to handle and prioritize tasks effectively
  • Be up to date of the latest trends in customer marketing, martech, customer experience and customer engagement
  • Have an appetite to innovate Salesforce solutions to drive improvements in both customer and colleague experience
  • Have a passion for continual personal development

Secondary requirements

It would be excellent, but not at all crucial, if the candidate has:

  • Public Sector experience (central government, healthcare, transportation, etc.) or Education experience
  • Hands on experience on Salesforce Data Cloud (Data360)
  • Relevant digital marketing qualifications or equivalent work experience with demonstrated proficiency
  • Experience with product management or implementation

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

 About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

 We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

 Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

 Our Core Technologies

 Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

 What You'll Do

 • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

 • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

 • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

 • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

 • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

 • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

 • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

 • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

 • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

 • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

 • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

 What We Look For:

 • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

 • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

 • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

 • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

 • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

 • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

 • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

 • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

 Nice To Have:

 • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

 • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

 • Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

 • Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

 • Conversation design or UX writing experience

 What We Offer You:

 • Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

 • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

 • Flexible PTO

 • Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

 • Health & wellness initiatives

description:
Privacy Compliance Associate - Glasgow

We are seeking a Privacy Compliance Associate to join our Data Governance & AI Non-Financial Risk team, supporting Morgan Stanley in meeting its privacy and data protection obligations. The role will work across business lines to help ensure global Data Subject Rights requests, including access and erasure requests, are managed appropriately and responded to within required timeframes.

In the Legal & Compliance division, we assist the Firm in achieving its business objectives by facilitating and overseeing the Firm's management of legal, regulatory and franchise risk. This is an Associate level position within the Privacy Non-Financial Risk (NFR) team who are part of the second line of defence, governing and overseeing data subject rights requests and privacy across the Firm.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

What you'll do in the role:

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm when responding to Data Subject Rights requests, including data subject access requests (DSARs) and erasure requests, within statutory deadlines.

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm with the intake, processing, redactions and quality assurance checks of request responses.

- Support Privacy NFR with oversight activity including monitoring of dashboards and production of metrics for reporting to colleagues, partners and governance groups.

- Support Privacy NFR by providing advice and guidance on global Data Subject Rights to key stakeholders across the Firm.

- Enhance policies, procedures, processes, reporting, training and support ad-hoc projects as required.

What you'll bring to the role:

- Ability to collaborate and partner with cross-functional teams, business units and individuals at all levels.

- Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines.

- Proactive work ethic and team player mindset.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- A passion for data protection and privacy.

- A willingness to learn and develop.

- Experience with One Trust Privacy Automation/ DSAR tool or similar is preferred.

At least 2 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role.

This Role is unable to offer Sponsorship.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Slack

Slack is your Digital HQ - bringing people, apps, customers, and AI agents together in one place. Millions of people use Slack every day to communicate, collaborate, and get work done. As work becomes increasingly distributed and AI-powered, Slack is redefining how teams operate and achieve at scale. In this AI era, Slack's mission remains making people's work lives simpler, more pleasant, and more productive.

The Team

The Slack Mobile team builds Slack's mobile experiences, from core messaging to AI and everything in between.

We operate at the intersection of product innovation, mobile platform excellence, and large-scale engineering. The features and systems we build support millions of daily users and require deep investments in performance, reliability, accessibility, and user experience.

The Role

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to help shape the future of Slack's mobile product. As a Prototyping Engineer, you'll embed as a leader on greenfield, zero-to-one initiatives. You'll influence product and design direction through engineering work that builds and ships the first versions of newly-imagined, fully working product features. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and fellow mobile engineers to help innovate some of the biggest new product opportunities for Slack, with experiences that are intuitive, performant, and reliable for millions of users worldwide.

This is a role for a self-directed, creative engineer who can operate with high velocity and strong independent judgment, combining hands-on technical leadership with broad organizational influence. We are looking for someone who can start from an ambiguous problem, no defined path, and competing priorities, and work through that to frame the problem, align stakeholders on what matters most, and move quickly from idea to working prototype to a shipped experience. You will:

  • Shape the future of Slack on mobile by leading the engineering development of experiences used by millions of users every day, spanning multiple teams and the broader organization.
  • Lead the most complex, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from early technical exploration through production rollout and long-term evolution.
  • Lead feature prototyping to define the mobile user experience for Slack's biggest opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to shape experiences that balance user needs, technical constraints, and long-term maintainability.
  • Influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate team through technical leadership, product reviews, and mentorship.
  • Set and evangelize best practices for mobile feature development and operational excellence across the broader engineering organization.
  • Mentor senior engineers and contribute to the growth of the broader mobile engineering community within Slack.
  • A related technical degree required.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building complex, high-craft Android applications at scale.
  • Proven track record of moving outside of organizational boundaries to start new initiatives, prototype the path to production, and reorient the organization to support the new initiative.
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments, whether at a start-up, in an incubator, or on a zero-to-one team inside a larger enterprise.
  • Proven track record of leading large, ambiguous, org-spanning technical initiatives with significant business impact.
  • Deep expertise in Kotlin framework and modern Android development.
  • Strong understanding of Android architecture, application lifecycle, concurrency, networking, and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence product and technical direction through expertise and collaboration, driving alignment across executive stakeholders, Engineering/Product/Design leadership, and multiple teams.
  • A bias toward ownership, execution, and continuous improvement, with the judgment to prioritize the highest-leverage work across the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture patterns. Experience with Kotlin coroutines, and dependency injection frameworks (e.g. Metro, Dagger).
  • Experience leading large-scale new products, features, or product transformations spanning multiple teams or the whole org.
  • Experience using research, usability testing, data, and experimentation to ground decisions and uncover opportunities.
  • Contributions to open source projects or the Android community, or other external recognition of technical leadership.
  • Experience building collaboration, productivity, messaging, AI, or enterprise software products.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Strong product intuition and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.

Unleash Your Potential

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Director of Security Engineering
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

 About the Role

 Abnormal AI protects organizations from the most sophisticated email and collaboration attacks using behavioral AI. Security is not a bolt-on at Abnormal; it is core to the product we sell and the trust our customers place in us. Our security organization operates a commercial cloud environment and a separate FedRAMP-authorized environment, and we are pursuing increasingly rigorous federal authorizations as we grow.

 We are hiring a Director of Security reporting to the CISO and leading the Security Engineering organization. You will build and scale high-performing security teams, own major security programs end to end, and operate autonomously in the CISO's absence, including representing security to executive leadership, customers, and auditors.

 This is a role for a deeply technical leader with a software engineering background who has grown into people leadership. You have built security teams from the ground up, you write and review code and architecture when it matters, and you believe the best security organizations earn their influence through partnership rather than policy enforcement.

 Our Security Philosophy

 We run security the way the best engineering-led companies do:

• Security reduces toil. Our job is to make the rest of the company faster and safer at the same time. If a control adds friction without reducing risk, it is a defect.

• Paved paths, safe by default. We invest in guardrails, golden paths, and secure-by-default infrastructure so the easy choice is the secure choice. We prefer preventing classes of problems over chasing individual findings.

• Partnership over gatekeeping. Security succeeds only through deep collaboration with engineering, IT, and business teams. We embed with builders, we ship alongside them, and we take on their constraints as our own.

• Engineering-grade rigor. We treat security problems as engineering problems: automated, measurable, code-reviewed, and continuously improved.

 If the security cultures that value freedom and responsibility, context over control, and guardrails over gates resonate with you, you will feel at home here.

 What You Will Do

• Serve as deputy to the CISO: act with full authority in the CISO's absence and represent the security organization to executives, customers, and regulators.

• Lead, coach, and grow managers and senior engineers across Security Engineering and Security Operations.

• Own the security engineering roadmap: cloud security architecture (AWS-first), detection and response, identity, vulnerability management, and secure-by-default platform investments.

• Drive cross-functional programs with Engineering, IT, and Product, from AI security governance to data perimeter controls to federal compliance initiatives.

• Set and defend engineering standards for the security organization: everything as code, automated where possible, measured against outcomes rather than activity.

• Build hiring pipelines and raise the bar on every hire; own performance management, promotion cases, and succession planning within your teams.

• Translate technical risk into business terms for the executive team and board, and translate business priorities into a coherent security strategy.

 Must Haves

• 10+ years in security or software engineering, including 4+ years managing security teams, ideally including managers of managers or equivalent scope.

• A genuine software engineering background: you have shipped production software, and you evaluate security solutions the way an engineer would.

• A proven record of building and scaling high-performing security teams, with alumni who would work for you again.

• Deep technical fluency in cloud-native environments: AWS organizations and multi-account governance, Kubernetes, identity and access, detection engineering, and modern SDLC security.

• Demonstrated cross-functional leadership: you have earned the trust of engineering leaders and shipped security outcomes through their teams, not around them.

• Strong written communication: you produce decision-ready documents and can drive alignment asynchronously.

• Executive presence: comfortable presenting to C-level leadership, customers, and auditors without preparation from the CISO.

 Strong Signals

• You are currently a security engineering manager or senior manager at a fintech, high-growth startup, or forward-leaning enterprise, and you are ready for broader scope.

• You have built paved-path or secure-by-default platforms that measurably reduced both risk and developer friction.

• Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) without letting compliance define the security program.

• Experience securing AI/ML systems or governing AI adoption at scale.

• You have operated in environments where security headcount was scarce and automation was the only way to scale.

 Why This Role

 You will inherit strong teams, an executive staff that treats security as a first-class function, and a CISO who wants a true partner rather than a lieutenant. The scope is broad, the autonomy is real, and the ceiling on this role is defined by what you take on.

description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Research Data Expert to join our Data team. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management.

In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.

HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving  the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain
  • Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets
  • Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation
  • Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities
  • Analyze data to identify and improve alpha
  • Manage the full end-to-end data pipeline, from raw vendor ingestion to refined feature sets
  • Provide on-call support for data issues during normal business hours
  • Design and implement automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts

Qualifications

  • Strong programming skills (Python/R preferred) and proficiency in data science methodologies
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a specific data domain (e.g., alternative data, fundamentals, security reference, or economic data)
  • Proven track record of building alpha through detailed data analysis
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Undergraduate degree in a STEM field

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

title: Software Engineer - Query Execution
description:
Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

 Be Part of Building the Future

 Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com.

 About the role
Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, building the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.

 As a Software Engineer, you’ll work with experienced engineers to build, test, and support well-scoped improvements to the execution engine. You’ll learn how Dremio’s query runtime works while contributing to areas such as query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, scheduling, and performance.

 What you’ll be doing

• Build and support execution-engine components: Implement, test, debug, and maintain well-defined changes to query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, and resource management.

• Develop reliable software: Write clear, maintainable Java code; add unit and integration tests; and follow established engineering practices for code review, testing, and documentation.

• Investigate issues: Help diagnose query correctness, reliability, and performance issues using query profiles, logs, telemetry, benchmarks, and production data.

• Learn runtime and performance fundamentals: Build familiarity with vectorized processing, concurrency, memory usage, parallelism, data exchange, and disk spilling.

• Collaborate with the team: Work closely with senior engineers and partner teams to understand requirements, break work into manageable tasks, and deliver incremental improvements.

• Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation, while validating results through testing, review, and sound engineering judgment.

• Grow your engineering skills: Participate actively in design discussions and code reviews, seek feedback, and steadily take on broader technical responsibility.

 What we’re looking for

• Software engineering foundation: Up to two years of professional software development experience, or equivalent experience through internships, coursework, or substantial personal projects.

• Programming skills: Proficiency in Java or another object-oriented programming language; willingness to learn and work in a large Java codebase.

• Computer science fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and basic concurrency concepts.

• Problem-solving ability: Able to work through well-defined technical problems, ask good questions, and apply feedback to reach a solution.

• Quality mindset: Commitment to writing tested, maintainable code and learning established development, testing, and review practices.

• Communication and collaboration: Able to communicate progress, surface blockers early, and work effectively with teammates.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Bonus points if you have

•

• Exposure to database internals, query processing, distributed systems, or large-scale data processing.

• Familiarity with performance-oriented software concepts such as profiling, memory management, concurrency, or vectorized processing.

• Experience with C++, Apache Arrow, Parquet, Apache Iceberg, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.

• Contributions to open-source projects.

 What we value

 At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.

 Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.

 Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

 Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice.

 Important Security Notice for Candidates

 At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement here .

 Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

title: Senior Director, Field Enablement
description:
Headquarters: Remote (USA - San Francisco, CA)

 PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

 PagerDuty is seeking a Sr. Director, Field Enablement to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As Sr. Director of Field Enablement, you will lead a team of enablement professionals supporting our sales, customer success, and partnership organizations.

 You will build and scale our global enablement function to ensure our customer-facing teams are equipped to sell and support our diversifying product portfolio as we enter our next phase of growth. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the enablement strategy for a high-growth SaaS company and directly improve teams' capabilities and productivity worldwide. The ideal candidate is a strategic, seasoned enablement leader passionate about gathering customer feedback and competitive intelligence to develop programs that drive sales excellence and business results.

 ABOUT PAGERDUTY

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, execute, optimize, and assess enablement programs in partnership with sales and customer success leadership, determining priorities and success metrics with key stakeholders

• Gather and share insights from customers, competitors, and the market to enable the positioning of PagerDuty’s value proposition to the market

• Drive the creation of learning programs and events that align with overall sales and company strategy, enhancing team capabilities, productivity, and high-level selling skills

• Build and maintain an enablement delivery platform that provides scalable, measurable content and learning resources to sales, customer success, and partnership teams

• Collaborate with marketing and product marketing to develop highly effective and repeatable sales messaging, selling tools, and collateral that enable consistent execution

• Design and maintain an end-to-end sales onboarding program in collaboration with HR that certifies new hires on company strategy, product messaging, and sales processes

• Develop and lead the everboarding process for the sales team to ensure the continued development of required behaviors and skills to successfully operate a consumption driven business

• Build out and scale enablement support functions for Customer Success and Partnerships organizations

• Communicate the enablement strategy, roadmap, and KPIs to stakeholders across all global organizations

• Develop and maintain a library of sales enablement resources, including sales playbooks, battle cards, product collateral, content library, and competitive intelligence

• Drive adoption and utilization of sales enablement tools such as MindTickle and Highspot

• Partner with the sales systems team to drive adoption and utilization of sales tools such as Clari, Salesloft, Salesforce, and others

• Conduct regular assessments and audits of sales processes and identify areas for improvement and optimization.

• Set key metrics to assess the impact of sales enablement efforts on sales performance

• Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in sales enablement

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA is a plus

• 10+ years of sales enablement experience or a combination of sales / post sales, sales training, and enablement roles

• 5+ years of management experience leading and developing enablement teams

• Proven track record of building and delivering innovative, strategic sales enablement programs, including training, onboarding, certifications, and sales events

• Experience implementing and maintaining content management platforms such as Highspot or Seismic

• 3+ years of experience in high-velocity, high-growth startup environments, preferably in the SaaS space, or equivalent degree or experience

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong understanding of sales methodologies such as Force Management, MEDDIC and forecasting best practices

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively train and influence sales professionals at all levels

• Experience with Sales Operations and Salesforce.com

• Proficiency in using sales enablement tools, CRM systems, and content management platforms. Preferred platforms include Salesforce, Seismic, CRM Analytics, and more

• Analytical mindset with the ability to provide actionable insights

• Knowledge of Sales Manager training and sales coaching, particularly for Enterprise sales

• Strong program and project management skills with the ability to maintain calendars of ongoing training, business reviews, and field communications

• Detail and results-oriented with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on execution

• Collaborative and team-oriented approach with the ability to work cross-functionally

• Self-motivated and results-driven with a passion for driving sales excellence

• Excel in creating and curating sales collateral, playbooks, training modules, and other resources to support the sales team

• Have a track record of driving sales enablement initiatives across different regions and markets, understanding cultural nuances and local sales practices

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Argentina Remote

 Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

 About the Role

 We’re looking for a S enior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

• Location: Remote-first (Argentina)

• Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)

• Application Information:

• Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

• This posting is for a new position.

 As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will:

• Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.

• Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.

• Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.

• Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.

• Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.

• Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

 About you

 You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

• Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

• Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.

• Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.

• Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.

• Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.

• Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.

• Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

 It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:

• Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.

• Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana

• Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.

• Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

 You Are:

• Collaborative : You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.

• Strategic thinker : You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.

• Comfortable with ambiguity : You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.

 If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

 Our Core Behaviors:

• Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

• Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

• Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

• Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

 Benefits

• Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

• Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

• Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

• Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

• Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

• Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.

• Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

• Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

 Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Abuse Research Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote from the US

 Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team

 Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.

 What you’ll do

 As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.

 Responsibilities

• Proactive Threat Hunting & Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.

• FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints.

• Threat Intelligence & Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows.

• Cross-Functional Advisories & Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security.

• Agentic Testing & Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls.

 Who you are

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.

• 5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.

• B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.

• Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.

• Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.

 Preferred qualifications

• Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).

• Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&CK.

• Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.

• Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.

• Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.

• Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).

PLACEMENT STUDENT - Supply Chain Logistics, Darlington

We are looking for an enthusiastic Supply Chain Logistics Placement Student to join our team specializing in Logistics for our Corporate/CBS Segment in Darlington, UK. During your placement with us, you will learn how a major global organization operates, gaining the tools and exposure you will need to become an expert in the industry.

This role is available to candidates who qualify for a placement year and will commence Summer of 2027.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Support day-to-day transportation and logistics operations for inbound and outbound shipments; assist with the planning, booking, tracking, and monitoring of road, air, ocean, and courier shipments.
  • Liaise with carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to resolve transportation issues and support service delivery; monitor shipment progress and proactively communicate risks, delays, and recovery actions.
  • Support the preparation and validation of shipping documentation, customs documentation, commercial invoices, and transportation paperwork; assist with transportation planning during peak demand periods, plant shutdowns, and operational constraints.
  • Support freight cost control by identifying consolidation opportunities and alternative transportation solutions; participate in carrier performance reviews and support the measurement of service, cost, and compliance metrics.
  • Investigate shipment exceptions, delays, and service failures and support implementation of corrective actions; support continuous improvement projects focused on transportation efficiency, lead time reduction, service improvement, and cost savings.
  • Develop KPI reporting and logistics dashboards to improve operational visibility and decision-making; work collaboratively with Planning, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Customer Support, Shipping, Warehousing, and Trade Compliance teams to support uninterrupted supply chain operations.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Studying towards a degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Economics, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Strong interest in transportation, logistics, and global supply chain operations; excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment along with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities; great communication skills and confidence working with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, Access, or similar analytical tools would be beneficial but is not essential.

 Job Title: Principal Software Engineer, AI

 Location : Remote - US

 Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.
